# Granite Vision qualification fixtures

These six synthetic images were created for `docling-mlx` and contain no model
weights or third-party source material.

- `table-simple.png`: two-column table with a title.
- `table-merged.png`: two-column table with a spanning heading.
- `table-multi.png`: two independent tables on one page.
- `chart-bar.png`, `chart-line.png`, `chart-pie.png`: labeled charts with known
  categories and values.

They qualify the adapter boundary against the pinned official Granite Vision
4.1 artifact. They are not reference captures from the model.
